_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A failed raw upload is retried using the retained audio bytes. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The first recording upload (POST /api/upload/raw) fails with "upload unavailable"; later ones succeed with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/retried-upload.webm. Call "uploads" reports them as "<count> <same|different>": "same" when every upload's bytes equal the first's. Message submissions are accepted without being sent on, and call "chats" counts them. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button. The recording state should become "recording".
2. Click the stop button. [data-testid="recording-retained"] should become visible, and [data-testid="recording-error"] should contain "upload unavailable".
3. Call "chats" must return "0", and window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks should become 1.
4. Click the retry button. No recording panel should remain (count 0).
5. Call "uploads" must return "2 same", call "chats" must return "1", and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts must be 1.
